note: What build_bundle.py puts in a bundle. Sources are relative to the repository root. class is derived, never declared. `uses` names code components whose behaviour this data component relies on: when both change, the build refuses unless `requires_component` names that code at its new version. `version` is read from SKILL.md for skills and declared here for the rest.
